admission.justification: Certifying against another candidate's groups answers a conforming row with the wrong item, the failure the Reviewer sealed as L175-F01; the two named refusals and the bound-run positive case hold both directions.

applicability: The closeout validator's read of a leaf's persisted worklist run on converted memory.
conditions: The run is present, readable and complete, and records the code base commit, code candidate tree and memory base commit of the candidate being certified.
Group membership still agrees with the onboarding cards on disk.
exclusions: A run is not recomputed inside certification: the validator binds to the recorded run rather than judging a second tree.
The memory-quality entry needs no staleness class, because it reads the run of its own request.

evidence: A legitimate complete run of an earlier candidate is refused by name ("its code candidate tree is 'fb59baa4…', this candidate's is '1004c29c…'") and a bound current run still closes the same row in all three consumers; a card added to a grouped member after the run is refused naming the group and the member.

statement: The closeout validator uses a persisted worklist run's identical-copy groups only when that run describes the candidate being certified — its recorded code base commit, code candidate tree and memory base commit are the leaf's, and no group lists a member that has since gained an onboarding card — and otherwise refuses by name with the recompute command.
